answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve 1 exclusive communication slot, acting as a protected harbor for valid session traffic. An honest participant maintains this single reservation at a steady cost, whereas 1,000 fakes must pay an immense, non-linear sum to hold such parallel capacity. A verifier inspects the orchard of connection logs for occupancy overlaps; any confirmed breach triggers immediate, permanent account revocation. Like a coral reef, the network ecosystem naturally collapses under the weight of redundant identities.
